svg.title: Same Instruction, Different User Personas: Personalized Robot Actions.
svg.desc: Two users provide profiles containing only a dominant-hand attribute and give the identical instruction, Set up my desk for work. One personal robot policy reads the profile, instruction and scene, infers a task-relevant persona that prioritizes computer use, plans and executes. The policy connects its inferred plan directly to a small robot on each Before-to-After transition. The robot places the mouse on the user's dominant-hand side. The paper notebook is shown set aside to keep the workspace clear in this illustrative arrangement. Both before views reuse the same Task 1 initial desk state; the keyboard and monitor stay fixed. Object labels are integrated into each desk view. Held-out user preferences go only to evaluation. This is a conceptual mouse-layout illustration, not a measured rollout result.
